recommendations.recommendation: Begin each day expecting to meet difficult people, without being harmed or angered by them.
recommendations.rationale: They act from ignorance of good and evil, and we are made to work together like hands and feet.

recommendations.recommendation: Do each act as though it were the last of your life.
recommendations.rationale: This removes aimlessness, passion, hypocrisy, and self-love.

recommendations.recommendation: Live in accordance with nature and reason, accepting what happens as part of the whole.
recommendations.rationale: Everything that happens is fitting for the universe, and the part should accept what serves the whole.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Recognize that disturbance comes from your judgments, not from things themselves.
recommendations.rationale: Remove the judgment and the sense of harm disappears; things cannot touch the soul.

recommendations.recommendation: Retreat into yourself rather than seeking retreats in the country or by the sea.
recommendations.rationale: Nowhere is there a quieter or freer retreat than one's own mind.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not fear death; see it as a natural dissolution.
recommendations.rationale: Death is a natural process like birth; whether dispersal or change, it is nothing to fear.

recommendations.recommendation: Disregard fame and posthumous reputation.
recommendations.rationale: All will soon be forgotten, and those who remember will also die.

recommendations.recommendation: Work for the common good.
recommendations.rationale: What is not good for the hive is not good for the bee; humans are social by nature.

recommendations.recommendation: Get up in the morning to do the work of a human being.
recommendations.rationale: We were born to act, not to lie in bed in comfort.

recommendations.recommendation: Stop arguing about what a good person is and be one.
recommendations.rationale: Talk about virtue is useless without practice.

recommendations.recommendation: Forgive those who wrong you; the best revenge is not to become like them.
recommendations.rationale: Wrongdoers act from ignorance, and imitating them harms yourself.

recommendations.recommendation: Be grateful to family, teachers, and friends for the virtues you learned from them.
recommendations.rationale: Book 1 lists what he learned from each person, showing his debt to others.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not waste time thinking about others' affairs unless it serves the common good.
recommendations.rationale: Such thoughts distract from your own ruling faculty and duties.

recommendations.recommendation: Live in the present moment.
recommendations.rationale: Only the present can be lost; the past and future do not belong to us.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid anger; genuine kindness is invincible.
recommendations.rationale: Anger is weakness, and gentleness is more human and stronger.

recommendations.recommendation: Be like a rock that stands firm against the waves.
recommendations.rationale: Misfortune borne nobly is good fortune.

recommendations.recommendation: See things as they are by breaking them into their components.
recommendations.rationale: Analyzing things removes false grandeur, as a purple robe is just dyed sheep's wool.

recommendations.recommendation: Accept correction and change your mind when shown wrong.
recommendations.rationale: Seeking truth harms no one; persisting in error does.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid being corrupted by power; stay simple, good, and serious.
recommendations.rationale: Power dyes the soul, and one must resist becoming an emperor in that sense.

recommendations.recommendation: Love the people fate has placed around you.
recommendations.rationale: Fate assigned these people as your companions; accept and love them sincerely.

recommendations.recommendation: Whether the world is governed by providence or by atoms, act rightly.
recommendations.rationale: Either way, virtue is still the right response.

recommendations.recommendation: Do good without seeking thanks, like a vine bearing grapes.
recommendations.rationale: Doing good is natural to humans; expecting thanks spoils it.

recommendations.recommendation: Remember that everything changes and nothing lasts.
recommendations.rationale: The universe is change, and life is opinion; seeing this reduces attachment.

recommendations.recommendation: Distinguish what is in your power, your judgments and choices, from what is not.
recommendations.rationale: Only one's own choices are good or bad; external things are indifferent.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
